ai_summary: ## Executive Summary:  ACME Solar Holdings Limited has announced the commissioning of an additional 88.02 MW / 366.969 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) component in Rajasthan, with commercial operations set to begin on November 1, 2026. This expands their subsidiary's cumulative commissioned BESS capacity to 159.660 MW / 664.261 MWh, marking significant progress on the FDRE Project and enhancing future revenue potential. The update reflects positive project execution without any apparent material negative impacts or red flags.
